flow: Infected Homosexual Men (untreated)->AIDS living with AIDS
Infected Heterosexual Men (untreated)->AIDS living with AIDS
Treated with ART->AIDS living with AIDS
param: C Constant recruitment into susceptible individuals (total recruitment rate). Recruitments split by h and c.
h Proportion of men in recruitment.
c Proportion of heterosexual men among men in recruitment.
p Proportion of initially treated individuals.
l Natural mortality rate (applies to all classes).
d Induced disease mortality rate for individuals living with AIDS.
δ AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance or treatment failure (symbol not given in excerpt; included as δ to distinguish from AIDS mortality d).
a Departure rate from all compartments of infected individuals (most sensitive parameter per Results/Conclusions).
c_s Number of heterosexual partners (used in Scenario 1 to modify R0_het).
c_h Number of homosexual partners (referenced in Conclusions as sensitive).
c_hw Number of partners between homosexual men and women (Scenario 3 / Conclusions).
c_hm Number of partners between homosexual men and heterosexual men (Scenario 3 / Conclusions).
R0_hom Basic reproduction number for homosexual transmission (discussed as most influential).
R0_het Basic reproduction number for heterosexual transmission.
C_h_(1-c) Recruitment into Susceptible Homosexual Men.
C_(1-h) Recruitment into Susceptible Women.
C_h_c Recruitment into Susceptible Heterosexual Men.
β_HH Transmission/contact rate: Susceptible Homosexual Men infected by Infected Homosexual Men.
β_WH Transmission/contact rate: Susceptible Women infected by Infected Homosexual Men.
β_WM Transmission/contact rate: Susceptible Women infected by Infected Heterosexual Men.
β_MW Transmission/contact rate: Susceptible Heterosexual Men infected by Infected Women.
β_MH Transmission/contact rate: Susceptible Heterosexual Men infected by Infected Homosexual Men.
τ ART initiation/enrollment rate from infected (untreated) to Treated (with ART).
ρ AIDS development rate from infected (untreated) to AIDS.
